entry_points.text: MSI exposed via prepare/teardown; IRQ via select, alloc, free, activate and deactivate ops.

V4 mask/unmask adjust enabled property via parent record then invalidate; invalidate uses direct op with direct LPIs else proxy device under proxy lock. Doorbell pending supports only pending state via redistributor with sync or proxy; retrigger equals set-pending. V4.1 follows with broadcast doorbell invalidate, no-op if no 4.1 ITS.

SGI mask/unmask flip stored enable and reissue config without clearing pending. Pending supports only pending: set encodes VPE id and interrupt into 4.1 ITS generation control, clear reissues config with clear flag. Property update honors only PROP_UPDATE_VSGI then reconfigures.

DT discovery sweeps ITS-compatible children twice: first resets every available MSI controller aborting on failure; second skips unavailable/non-MSI with warning, builds node from registers and NUMA, probes, destroys on failure. PM binds save-disable to suspend and restore-enable to resume via syscore ops.

exports.text: Helpers expose domain OF node, CPU number from redistributor typer, and flags for single-target, affinity-on-activate and resend-when-in-progress. Typer carries a 16-bit CPU number also used for collection targets.
Per-CPU ITS entry runs only when an ITS exists; it makes redistributor LPIs safe then builds per-CPU tables and collections, aborting if disable fails.

hazards.text: Repeat MSI prepare for same device id reuses existing device and marks shared; teardown retains shared devices and refuses to free while any LPI bits set; id colliding with VPE proxy device without direct LPIs is rejected.

SGI status polls up to 1s with spacing, logs rate-limited and fails ENXIO on expiry; parse-commit polls 500 sleeps with warn on expiry. Tables require ITS disabled and quiescent. Pre-translation window clears isolated-MSI flag; non-shareable needs explicit cache maintenance. EINVAL for bad states, commands or eager affinity on dead VPE; ENOMEM for alloc shortfalls; affinity OK codes differ for VPE and SGI.

invariants.text: Firmware tables accepted only if boot redistributor has LPIs on and property base in reserved range; else allocate shared property plus one pending page per CPU. Per-CPU bringup is idempotent, programs shareable cacheable bases with fallback, enables LPIs and orders before marking enabled. Shutdown skips if off or hotplug/preallocated, else disables and bounded-waits. Pages reserved once per CPU for kexec; mismatched bases taint or warn.

Each CPU binds one collection per ITS, skipping NUMA-mismatched ITS, using redistributor base or typer CPU number by mode, then map plus invalidate-all. Without direct-move each ITS takes a small slot from a global bitmap. Tables found by scanning base registers; indirect levels allocate zeroed pages on demand, flush when non-shareable, install valid with ordering; VPE tables backed on every v4 ITS and per-CPU copy where needed.

Parent alloc expects 3-field edge spec for firmware parents, 2-field for irqchip parents. Alloc reserves HW range and parents, records HW number; activate picks online CPU, accounts, publishes affinity and maps; deactivate unaccounts and discards; free releases bitmap and parents.

4.1 ITS lookup prefers per-CPU cache then first capable ITS. SGI config from stored prio/enable/group sent to first 4.1 ITS; SGI affinity only records mask. VPE ids from bounded allocator; init allocates id, pending page and table entry with unwind; teardown unmaps proxy and frees.

Node zeroed with locks, typer, bases, default message hook, isolated plus immutable flags, NUMA and firmware handle; destroy unmaps and frees. Probe applies quirks, handles v4, allocates queue, tables and collections, programs base, enables, creates hierarchical MSI domain, publishes under global lock, unwinding on failure. Queue uses writeback inner-shareable with valid, falling back to non-cached non-shareable with explicit flush. Quirks adjust widths, entry size, bases or flags.

locks.text: Global ITS lock covers collection bringup and save/restore walks including register access and unwind.
Device list searched and mutated under ITS lock with IRQs saved. Proxy map/unmap/move use proxy lock when indirect; 4.1 per-CPU invalidate holds redistributor lock then syncs.

V4 invalidate holds VM mapping lock, issues one invalidate to first eligible ITS. 4.1 blocking deschedule holds per-VPE lock while arming doorbell; 4.1 invalidate samples CPU under selector lock. SGI read nests selector outside redistributor lock.

state_machines.text: VPE handover polls dirty with bounded waits, clears valid plus caller bits while setting caller bits, re-polls, reports pending-last if still dirty.

Device vectors rounded up to power of two within ITS limit; tables sized with minimum, storage plus LPI and CPU maps allocated, flushed, initialized with event lock, linked and mapped. IRQs carve contiguous power-of-two regions; teardown frees LPIs, unmaps and releases.

Affinity on dead VPE rejects under eager or records first CPU under lazy; live prefers CPU sharing table mask, keeps current if acceptable, else first requested; on change updates cache, requests move, applies vendor invalidate, relocates proxy, publishes affinity. Proxy unmap discards and frees; map evicts then assigns round-robin; move clears old doorbell with sync when direct else moves proxy event.

V4 and v4.1 vCPU affinity multiplex schedule, deschedule, commit and invalidate; others rejected. Schedule programs bases from VM and VPE pages with shareability and marks valid; deschedule clears valid saving hints with 4.1 splitting blocking/non-blocking; commit polls parse completion; invalidate refreshes caches across fabric or at current redistributor.

SGI domain provisions 16 entries per VPE disabled with zero prio, marked non-lazy; free is no-op; activate writes config; deactivate disables then issues reconfigure plus pending-clear separately. VPE domain reserves power-of-two LPI bitmap, picks 4.1 chip with residual ids, binds doorbells with resend; free releases parents and clears bits. Activation pins to first online CPU, mapping eagerly only under eager policy; deactivation unmaps eagerly and flushes when empty. Proxy array used only without direct invalidation.

Quiescence clears enable then polls for quiescent with bounded counter and tiny delay, returning busy on expiry. Suspend saves control, forces quiescence, saves command base, unwinds in reverse on failure. Resume re-quiesces, rewrites base, realigns pointers, rewrites valid tables, restores control and re-inits local collection when id below HW count.

structs.text: Device: ITS owner, translation storage, event map with LPI bitmap and CPU map, id, link, shared flag. ITS: quirks, NUMA, bases, tables, device list, per-CPU collections, MSI hook. Redistributor: flags, pending page, property base, locks, caps. VPE/VM: map count, cached CPU, id, tables, doorbell, hints, per-SGI records; VM property page, bitmap, counts, lock.

V4 VPE chip: mask, unmask, parent EOI, affinity, retrigger, pending, vCPU affinity. 4.1 VPE chip: mask, unmask, parent EOI, affinity, vCPU affinity only. SGI chip: mask, unmask, affinity, pending set/get, vCPU affinity.

NUMA affinity is init array of u32 node plus u32 ITS id, SRAT-filled, linear-searched, freed once. Windows: control 64 KiB, ACPI 128 KiB, vSGIR 64 KiB at 128 KiB offset, one erratum 128 KiB offset; DT arm,gic-v3-its with msi-controller; ACPI PIDR2 arch 0x30/0x40. Collection count is 8-bit TYPER field guiding resume.
